$comment: MACHINE-READABLE ATTRIBUTE DELTA for the NextGen Metadata Framework (Metaflow) onboarding spec, v1.5.0 -> v1.5.01. Intended to be fed directly to an automated agent updating the Databricks App (databricks-app/) or any other spec-authoring surface. READ THIS FIRST: v1.5.01 changes ZERO onboarding-spec attributes. It is a repository-layout release -- resources/ was regrouped into subfolders. The correct app-side action is therefore NO CHANGE to any authoring surface: no registry entry, no attribute_knowledge entry, no validation rule, no template, no registry.js/Builder.jsx edit, and NO `npm run build`. This file exists so an agent working the release checklist can confirm that emptiness is the intended answer rather than inferring it from an absent file. READING RULE for `app_action`, unchanged from v1.5.0: every app_action states a FACT about the resulting UI, never a shorthand instruction.
app_build_rationale: `npm run build` is required only when a change alters what web/dist serves -- a field the framework now rejects, a new field, a changed default or predicate. Nothing in v1.5.01 touches web/src, config/registry/*, config/attribute_knowledge*.json, config/validation/rules.json or templates/**. Rebuilding would produce a new bundle hash with identical behaviour and no way to tell the two apart in review.

what_did_change.summary: resources/ went from 95 YAML files in one flat directory to six purpose-named subfolders, each globbed by its own `include:` line in databricks.yml. No resource key, job name, pipeline name, task, parameter, notebook or dependency changed; the fully-resolved bundle config is byte-identical to v1.5.0 (verified by diffing `databricks bundle validate -o json` before and after).

folders.resources/metaflow_config_jobs/: onboarding_job.yml (one spec per run) + framework_config_onboarding_job.yml (a whole spec_dir per run)
folders.resources/bt_tests/: the 6 resources driven by real BT fixtures: metaflow_test_104_geneva_tariffs_recon_{job,pipeline}.yml, metaflow_test_ing_004_asn1_decode_{job,pipeline}.yml, metaflow_test_ing_005_pgp_decrypt_{job,pipeline}.yml
folders.resources/stability_tests/: empty; reserved for metaflow_testing/STABILITY_TEST_PLAN.md's A1-G4 cases (README.md only)

what_did_change.relative_path_rule: Every relative path inside a resource YAML moved one level up: `../notebooks/...` -> `../../notebooks/...`, `../dist/*.whl` -> `../../dist/*.whl`, `source_code_path: ../databricks-app` -> `../../databricks-app`. DABs resolves a relative path against the declaring file, and `bundle validate` does NOT verify that the target exists, so a stale `../` fails only at deploy. Guarded by tests/unit/test_resource_layout.py.

app_repository_references_repointed.line_context: comment above the METAFLOW_* env-var override block

app_repository_references_repointed.change: same path repointed in the module docstring

deploy_contract_for_the_app.why_the_extra_selectors: The app resource resolves ${resources.jobs.onboarding_job.id} into METAFLOW_ONBOARDING_JOB_ID and binds ${var.catalog}.${var.spec_schema}.${var.spec_volume} to its service principal with WRITE_VOLUME. Selecting the app alone leaves those two references to be satisfied from prior deployment state.
deploy_contract_for_the_app.wheel: Still built by scripts/bump_and_build.py and uploaded under --select, because the selected jobs declare ../../dist/*.whl in environments[].spec.dependencies.
deploy_contract_for_the_app.app_deploy_is_still_two_steps: `bundle deploy` uploads source; the running app keeps serving its previous code until `databricks bundle run metaflow_onboarding_app`.
deploy_contract_for_the_app.never_do: Do not scope a deploy by commenting out an `include:` line. DABs treats a resource absent from the config as one to DELETE from the target, so commenting out resources/feature_tests/*.yml destroys 83 deployed jobs and pipelines on the next deploy.
